title: 第十三章 道路的复仇事件第十四章 蛮山雇佣兵团
content_zh:
“骑士大人这是我们小小的心意，请您跟您的兄弟好好喝一杯。”铂鹰旗南看来那些搜查士兵不友好，就拿出一枚十面值银币塞到穿着生锈的骑士铠甲的骑士手中道。
穿着生锈骑士铠甲的骑士看到手中的银币就满意对自己士兵提醒道：“兄弟们，对遵纪守法的商人，客气一点。”。
那些原本态度不善的士兵听到自己领主的家族骑士的话，态度立马变的友善并快速检查后跳下姆鲁兽车。
“大人，这辆姆鲁兽车没有问题！”“大人，这里也没有问题！”陆陆续续五名代表士兵向穿着生锈骑士铠甲的骑士汇报道。
“铂鹰旗南阁下，真是抱歉！我们也遵从我们领主大人吩咐检查，最近领地走私商人太多了。”穿着生锈骑士铠甲的骑士对铂斯特罗抱歉道。
“骑士大人，既然我们没有问题，不知道我们是不是可以离开了？”铂鹰旗南听到眼前骑士的抱歉的话就询问道。
“既然你们不是走私商人，当然可以离开！”“兄弟们让出一条路让他们过去。”穿着生锈骑士铠甲的骑士听到铂斯特罗的话就回应，然后对自己属下士兵大声吩咐道。
颜铁龙他们从新上了姆鲁兽车，赶着姆鲁兽经过那些像是农民的士兵身边，那些像农民的事，并没有出现不友好的行为，再接下来半个小时颜铁龙他们商队平安的离开麦落拜斯男爵领地。
“颜铁龙团长，刚刚那些像农民士兵真的是麦落拜斯男爵的士兵吗？我怎么感觉他们一点都不像啊。”欧斯派恩在出麦落拜斯男爵领地就对身边赶姆鲁兽车的颜铁龙问道。
颜铁龙听到欧斯特罗的问话就稍微想了想说道：“那些人应该不是麦落拜斯男爵的正规士兵，不过他们也麦落拜斯男爵的领民。
可能是那个骑士临时雇佣他们，找我们这些小商队弄一些钱花花，他们要是运气好真找走私商队就能发一笔不小财富。”。
“当然，还有另一种情况，那就是麦落拜斯男爵故意让打扮像农民的士兵来试探我们，而我们的周围可能早已埋伏了大量精锐士兵，等着我们做出不法的行为，就将我们剿灭。”颜铁龙一边赶姆鲁兽车，一边说出另一种可能道。
“啊！颜铁龙团长，我们只是小小商队，麦落拜斯男爵没必要用这种手段来对付我们吧。”欧斯派恩听到颜铁龙说另一种可能就说道。
“欧斯派恩，你难道没听刚刚那位骑士说他们那边最近走私商人多了起来，我想可能麦落拜斯男爵想用武力剿灭一支走私商队，达到杀鸡敬猴的效果吧，不过刚刚那种情况，肯定是那位骑士找我们这些小商队弄些钱花花。”颜铁龙说道。
其实刚刚那位骑士和那些穿着像农民的士兵就是来检测颜铁龙他们商队的，在颜铁龙他们检查地方的不远处森林中，隐藏着一支精锐的骑兵，只要先前骑士发出信号，那支精锐的骑兵就能迅速的冲击颜铁龙，这也就是像颜铁龙所说的麦落拜斯男爵要对走私商人杀鸡敬猴。
颜铁龙赶着姆鲁兽一小段时间，突然看到前面的姆鲁兽车停下，就急忙让自己这一辆姆鲁兽车停下，同时想知道前面发生什么事，可惜被前面姆鲁兽车货物挡住了自己的视线就疑惑说道：“前面又发生什么事？”。
“颜铁龙团长，我去看看！”欧斯派恩说完就跳下了姆鲁兽车，跑到前面查看情况。
颜铁龙在姆鲁兽车上等了一会儿，看欧斯派恩还没有回来，也下了姆鲁兽车向前走去。
当颜铁龙来到前面就看到一名魁梧长相有点豪放的大汉拿着长铁棍正跟五名山红雇佣兵团成员交战，而战场上那边已经倒下三昏迷不醒山红雇佣兵团成员。
颜铁龙搞不清楚眼前的状况就对身边姆鲁兽车上的铂鹰旗南指向战场询问道：“铂鹰旗南这到底是怎么一回事啊？”。

铂鹰旗南听到颜铁龙询问就直接解释道：“那个跟山红雇佣兵成员战斗的大汉叫骑米骆安，他是一个独狼雇佣兵，前几天跟山红雇佣兵团团长起了冲突，最后被山红雇佣兵团长带领十几人一起将他狠狠教训了一顿，没想他今天居然在这里来报仇。”。
“呵呵，铂斯派恩恭喜你了，等那些山红雇佣兵团成员全部倒地，就是宣布他们任务失败了，到时候你也不用付他们佣金了。”颜铁龙看到战场又晕倒二名山红雇佣兵团成员就幸灾乐祸道。
“颜铁龙大哥，你能不能帮帮山红雇佣兵团成员？”铂鹰旗南听到颜铁龙的幸灾乐祸并没有露出高兴的表情反而邹起眉头向颜铁龙拜托道。
颜铁龙听到铂斯派恩的拜托就意外问道：“铂鹰旗南你确定！要我帮那些山红雇佣兵团成员？”。
“颜铁龙大哥，我们酒馆以前护卫任务常常让山红雇佣兵团完成，我们酒馆也受到他们不少的恩惠，所以我希望你能帮帮他们。”铂鹰旗南神情认真的再一次拜托道。
“好，看在你和克米迪斯大叔的面子上，我就帮他们一回。”颜铁龙稍微考虑一下就同意道。
在颜铁龙要出手之时，在颜铁龙另一边的欧斯派恩却已经快速冲到骑米骆安大汉不到三米的距离。
颜铁龙看到欧斯派恩已经在骑米骆安三米的距离就停下脚步就自言自语说道：“真是性急家伙，这样也好，那就让我看看他上一次没有发挥出来的实力。”。
欧斯派恩一剑挡住骑米骆安对丧失战斗能力的山红雇佣兵成员的铁棍，并说道：“他已经没有抵抗能力了，阁下你也不要这么咄咄逼人！”
本来沉入报仇快感的骑米骆安即将打断已经没有抵抗力的山红雇佣兵团成员的右腿之时，突然被欧斯派恩用剑格挡了自己铁棍，同时欧斯派恩还用他不爽语气对他说教。
骑米骆安态度十分恶劣对欧斯派恩说道：“小子不要以为你有点本事就能管闲事，有些事不是你能插手的，不想受伤就给我赶紧滚开。”。
“我不会让你继续对弱者施暴！”欧斯派恩没有被恶劣突然的骑米骆安态度吓退缩，反而神情严肃认真道并爆发自己斗气道。
“既然你要找死，老子成全你！”骑米骆安说完也爆发斗气以及力量。
content_en:
"Sir Knight, this is our little kindness. Please have a drink with your brother." Platinum Eagle Qinan seemed that the searching soldiers were unfriendly, so he took out a ten-denomination silver coin and stuffed it into the hands of the knight wearing the rusty knight armor.
The knight wearing a rusty knight's armor was satisfied when he saw the silver coins in his hand and reminded his soldiers: "Brothers, be polite to businessmen who abide by the law.".
The soldiers who originally had a bad attitude immediately became friendly after hearing the words of their lord's family knight, and after a quick check, they jumped out of the Mulu beast cart.
"Sir, there is no problem with this Muru beast cart!" "Sir, there is no problem here either!" Five representative soldiers reported to the knight wearing rusty knight armor one after another.
"Your Excellency Platinum Eagle Banner, I'm so sorry! We also followed the instructions of our lord to inspect, and there have been too many smugglers in the territory recently." The knight wearing a rusty knight's armor apologized to Platostro.
"Sir Knight, since we have no problem, I wonder if we can leave?" Platinum Eagle Qinan asked after hearing the apologetic words of the knight in front of him.
"Since you are not smugglers, of course you can leave!" "Brothers, make a way for them to pass." The knight wearing rusty knight armor responded to Bostro's words, and then shouted instructions to his soldiers.
Yan Tielong and the others boarded the Mulu beast cart again, and drove the Mulu beast past the soldiers who looked like farmers. Those farmers-like things did not show any unfriendly behavior. In the next half hour, Yan Tielong and his caravan safely left the Baron of Melobas.
"Captain Yan Tielong, are those peasant soldiers just now really soldiers of Baron Melobas? Why do I feel like they look nothing like them at all." When Ospine left the territory of Baron Melobas, he asked Yan Tielong who was driving the Muru beast cart next to him.
Yan Tielong thought for a moment after hearing Ostero's question and said: "Those people should not be regular soldiers of Baron Melobas, but they are also subjects of Baron Melobas.
Maybe the knight hired them temporarily to get some money from small caravans like us. If they were lucky enough to find a smuggling caravan, they could make a lot of money. ".
"Of course, there is another situation, that is, Baron Melobais deliberately sent soldiers dressed like farmers to test us, and a large number of elite soldiers may have been ambushed around us, waiting for us to commit illegal acts and annihilate us." Yan Tielong said another possibility while driving the Mulu beast cart.
"Ah! Captain Yan Tielong, we are just a small caravan. There is no need for Baron Melobas to use this method to deal with us." Ospine said after hearing Yan Tielong mention another possibility.
"Ospine, didn't you hear that the knight just said that there have been more smugglers there recently? I think Baron Melobais wanted to use force to destroy a smuggling caravan to achieve the effect of killing chickens and respecting monkeys. But in the situation just now, it must be that knight looking for us small caravans to get some money to spend." Yan Tielong said.
In fact, the knight and the soldiers dressed like farmers just came to inspect Yan Tielong's caravan. In the forest not far from where Yan Tielong and the others inspected, there was an elite cavalry hidden. As long as the previous knight sent a signal, the elite cavalry could quickly attack Yan Tielong. This is what Yan Tielong said, Baron Melobais wanted to kill the chickens and respect the monkeys against the smugglers.
Yan Tielong drove the Mulu beast for a short time, and suddenly saw the Muru beast cart in front of him stop, so he hurriedly stopped his Muru beast cart. At the same time, he wanted to know what happened in front of him. Unfortunately, his sight was blocked by the cargo of the Muru beast cart in front, so he asked doubtfully: "What happened in front of me again?".
"Captain Yan Tielong, let me go take a look!" After saying this, Ospine jumped off the Mulu beast cart and ran toCheck the situation ahead.
Yan Tielong waited in the Mulu beast cart for a while. Seeing that Ospine had not returned yet, he also got off the Mulu beast cart and walked forward.
When Yan Tielong came to the front, he saw a burly man with a somewhat bold appearance holding a long iron rod fighting five members of the Shanhong Mercenary Group. Three members of the Shanhong Mercenary Group had fallen unconscious on the battlefield.
Yan Tielong couldn't figure out the situation at hand, so he asked Platinum Eagle Flagnan on the Mulu beast car beside him, pointing to the battlefield: "What on earth is going on with Platinum Eagle Flagnan?".
When Boying Qinan heard Yan Tielong's inquiry, he explained directly: "The big man who fought with the Shanhong mercenary members was called Qi Mi Luoan. He was a lone wolf mercenary. He had a conflict with the leader of the Shanhong mercenary group a few days ago. In the end, the leader of the Shanhong mercenary group led a dozen people to give him a severe lesson. I didn't expect that he would come here today to take revenge."
"Haha, Bosi Pine congratulates you. When all the members of the Shanhong Mercenary Group fall to the ground, it will be declared that their mission has failed, and you won't have to pay them commissions." Yan Tielong gloated when he saw two more members of the Shanhong Mercenary Group fainted on the battlefield.
"Brother Yan Tielong, can you help the members of the Shanhong mercenary group?" Boying Qinan did not show a happy expression when he heard Yan Tielong's gloating. Instead, he frowned and asked Yan Tielong.
Yan Tielong unexpectedly asked after hearing Bosi Pine's request: "Boying Qinan, are you sure! Do you want me to help those members of the Shanhong Mercenary Group?"
"Brother Yan Tielong, our tavern used to have the Shanhong mercenary group complete the escort missions, and our tavern also received a lot of favors from them, so I hope you can help them." Platinum Eagle Qinan asked again with a serious look.
"Okay, for the sake of you and Uncle Kemedis, I will help them." Yan Tielong agreed after thinking about it for a while.
When Yan Tielong was about to take action, Ospine, who was on the other side of Yan Tielong, had already rushed to a distance of less than three meters from the big man riding Miluo'an.
Yan Tielong saw that Ospine had stopped three meters away from Miluo An and said to himself: "What an impatient guy. That's fine. Then let me see the strength he didn't show last time.".
Ospine blocked the iron rod that Rider Miloan used against the Shanhong mercenary member who had lost the ability to fight with his sword, and said: "He has no ability to resist anymore. Don't be so aggressive, Your Excellency!"
Cavalier Miloan, who was already immersed in the pleasure of revenge, was about to break the right leg of the member of the Shanhong Mercenary Group who had no resistance, but Ospine suddenly blocked his iron rod with his sword. At the same time, Ospine lectured him in an unhappy tone.
Rider Milo'an had a very bad attitude and said to Ospine: "Boy, don't think that you can meddle in other people's business if you have some ability. There are some things that you can't interfere with. If you don't want to get hurt, get out of here."
"I will not let you continue to commit violence against the weak!" Ospine was not frightened by the harsh and sudden attitude of Cavalry Milo'an. Instead, he said with a serious expression and burst out with his own fighting spirit.
"Since you are seeking death, I will help you!" After Qi Mi Luoan said this, he also burst out with fighting spirit and strength.
